attchmntText: Signatureglobal (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 23, 2026, titled "Signature Global s GRESB Score Rises to 97.8, Securing 12th Position Globally Among Residential Peers".
voiceSummary: Signature Global India Limited announced that its Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark score rose to 97.8 from 84, securing a 4-Star rating and the 12th position globally among residential listed peers. The company achieved a perfect 100 percent in Reporting and 99.8 percent in Energy. Nearly all projects hold IGBC or EDGE certification, and over 9,700 trees were planted during the year. As of Q2FY27, the company delivered 19.9 million square feet of real estate. The project pipeline includes 23.2 million square feet of recently launched projects, 27.3 million square feet of forthcoming developments, and 9.2 million square feet of ongoing construction. The announcement was issued on 23rd November 2026 by Managing Director Ravi Aggarwal.

attchmntText: BLS Polymers Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: BLS Polymers Limited filed the transcript of its Q2 and H1 FY27 earnings conference call held on November 19, 2026. For Q2 FY27, consolidated revenues from operations stood at Rs. 125.56 crores, showing year-on-year growth of 28.92%. For H1 FY27, revenue increased by 35.63% to Rs. 232.59 crores. EBITDA grew by 41.47% to Rs. 33.57 crores, and PAT increased by 51% to Rs. 20.77 crores. The company currently operates a manufacturing capacity of 44,340 metric tons. It is executing an expansion plan to add 87,301 metric tons in the coming years. Management expects capacity to reach close to 55,000 tons by the end of FY27. Average EBITDA margin is projected at 13.25% with PAT margins of 7.5% to 8%. The company plans to reduce its trading revenue share and focus on manufacturing growth.

attchmntText: Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015   Certain statutory records presently not traceable
voiceSummary: Sanghvi Movers Limited intimates that certain statutory physical records relating to financial years between FY 2015-16 and FY 2025-26 are not traceable. The records were identified as missing in the third week of August 2026 during verification at the Registered Office. The Company states there is no indication of theft or unauthorized access. Electronic supporting records for the concerned meetings and matters are available and being preserved. The Company filed a police complaint with Hinjewadi Police Station on November 19, 2026. The Board was notified on November 19, 2026. The Company assesses no material impact on business operations, financial position, or going-concern status. No financial loss has been suffered. Record management controls are being strengthened.
